title: A robot on a gym floor: speed, position and distance

stimulus.title: A robot moving on a gym floor
stimulus.html:
A robot moves on a flat gym floor, set up as the xyxy-plane with distances in meters. For 0≤t≤50 \le t \le 5 seconds, its velocity components are given below, and at t=0t = 0 the robot is at the point (1,2)(1, 2). A graphing calculator is required.
Velocity components of the robot, in meters per second, and its position at t=0t = 0
QuantityValue
dxdt\frac{dx}{dt}4sin⁡(0.7t)−14\sin(0.7t) - 1 meters per second
dydt\frac{dy}{dt}2cos⁡(0.6t)+0.52\cos(0.6t) + 0.5 meters per second
(x(0),y(0))(x(0), y(0))(1,2)(1, 2)

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the speed of the robot at time t=4t = 4. Find the acceleration vector of the robot at time t=4t = 4.

rubric.point: Speed at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = 4</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{(x'(4))^2 + (y'(4))^2}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mn>1.032</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx 1.032</annotation></semantics></math> meters per second.
accept: the square root of the sum of the squared velocity components at t = 4, evaluated to 1.032

rubric.point: Acceleration vector: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟨</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">″</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">″</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left\langle x''(4), y''(4) \right\rangle</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟨</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2.638</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>0.811</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx \left\langle -2.638, -0.811 \right\rangle</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: both components from the calculator's numerical derivative, correct to three decimal places

parts.sample: Speed <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mn>2.8</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mn>2.4</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>0.5</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \sqrt{(4\sin 2.8 - 1)^2 + (2\cos 2.4 + 0.5)^2}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mn>1.032</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx 1.032</annotation></semantics></math> meters per second. Acceleration: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="bold">a</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{a}(4)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟨</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">″</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">″</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \left\langle x''(4), y''(4) \right\rangle</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟨</mo><mrow><mn>2.8</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mn>2.8</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1.2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mn>2.4</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \left\langle 2.8\cos 2.8, -1.2\sin 2.4 \right\rangle</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟨</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2.638</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>0.811</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx \left\langle -2.638, -0.811 \right\rangle</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find all times tt, for 0<t<50 < t < 5, at which the speed of the robot is 3 meters per second.

rubric.point: Sets up the equation <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.7</mn><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.6</mn><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>0.5</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{(4\sin(0.7t) - 1)^2 + (2\cos(0.6t) + 0.5)^2}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 3</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: speed = 3 written with the velocity components

parts.sample: Speed is 3 when <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.7</mn><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.6</mn><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>0.5</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{(4\sin(0.7t) - 1)^2 + (2\cos(0.6t) + 0.5)^2}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 3</annotation></semantics></math>. Solving on the calculator gives <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>1.462</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 1.462</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>2.507</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 2.507</annotation></semantics></math> seconds.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the position of the robot at time t=5t = 5.

rubric.point: Uses the initial position with an integral of each velocity component: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x(5)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 1</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">+</mo><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>5</mn></msubsup><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+ \int_0^5 x'(t)\,dt</annotation></semantics></math> or <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y(5)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 2</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">+</mo><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>5</mn></msubsup><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+ \int_0^5 y'(t)\,dt</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: initial value added to a definite integral from 0 to 5 of the velocity component, with dt

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Find the total distance traveled by the robot over the time interval 0≤t≤50 \le t \le 5.

rubric.point: Integral of speed: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>5</mn></msubsup><msqrt><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^5 \sqrt{(x'(t))^2 + (y'(t))^2}\,dt</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: the definite integral from 0 to 5 of the square root of the sum of the squared velocity components

parts.sample: Distance <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>5</mn></msubsup><msqrt><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.7</mn><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.6</mn><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>0.5</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \int_0^5 \sqrt{(4\sin(0.7t) - 1)^2 + (2\cos(0.6t) + 0.5)^2}\,dt</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mn>11.863</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx 11.863</annotation></semantics></math> meters.
